mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_menu WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.menu_nm, m.menu_path, m.parent_id, m.sort_order, m.icon FROM basic_menu m JOIN basic_menu_role mr ON mr.menu_id = m.id JOIN basic_role r ON r.id = mr.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.visible_yn = 'Y' AND mr.can_read = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_menu ( menu_nm, menu_path, api_path, parent_id, sort_order, icon, visible_yn, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{menuNm}, #{menuPath}, #{apiPath}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{visibleYn}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_menu SET menu_nm = #{menuNm}, menu_path = #{menuPath}, api_path = #{apiPath}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, icon = #{icon}, visible_yn = #{visibleYn}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
